_comment: Copy to gateway/routes.json and edit. The model ids below are FICTIONAL placeholders: replace them with the OpenCode model ids you approve. An id containing claude or anthropic is always refused. A data class is sensitive unless it says "sensitive": false, and a sensitive class reaches OpenCode only if it lists opencode under approved_providers.

general.description: Public code and text with nothing confidential in it.

internal.description: Your own unpublished code. Add "opencode" here only after you have read OpenCode's data terms.

client-data.description: Anything a client gave you or that identifies a client.
